note: A grass-and-gravel clearing about 25 m wide and 70 m long on the ridge top, at the end of a level 270-ft gravel driveway on the west side of Ridge Road, 0.7 mile south of the Crooked Run Road junction; open to the sky. The agency's campsite map layer marks it as having no trailer access, while the booking page sells it as an RV and trailer site with a 40-ft maximum. Reaching the ridge means a long forest-road climb: from PA 155 by Cowley Hill Road the steepest stretch measures about 8.5% for 850 m (7.4% over 1.2 km), then 7 miles of rolling ridge road, dirt or gravel; dry weather is the time for it. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 050 Tangle Snake still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 40 ft, clearance 20 ft, pull-in gravel driveway 270 ft graded Slight (3DEP: level, road 729 m, pin 729 m). Fees confirmed, $6.50 fee added; season written; facilities none. Imagery: clearing ~25 x 70 m with a trailer and a vehicle parked about 20 m north-west of the pin; pin on the clearing's east edge, not moved. Access via Cowley Hill Road 8.5% over 850 m: under the yardstick. NHD: nothing within 200 m.
flags: DCNR GIS layer vs booking page (ruling 5, kept, both in the note): the GIS record for this site says TrailerAccess 'No'; the booking page lists 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' and a 40-ft maximum vehicle length. The GIS point (41.57868,-78.13237) is 14 m from the booking point. Imagery shows a trailer parked in the clearing.

Season written (entry had none): opens 04-01, closes 12-12, from the site page's own statement ('open from the beginning of April through the end of rifle deer season') and 'Status: Open through Sat Dec 12 2026'. The engine's calendar is a little wider at the front: it shows nights Available from early March 2027 (Not Available through 5 March, Available on 11 March; 6-10 March not probed). I wrote the agency's stated April opening; a March night the engine sells is outside the stated season.

Access road: the page routes by Crooked Run Road east from PA 155 (4.3 mi) then Ridge Road south 0.7 mi; OSRM does not carry a Crooked Run Road through-route and went Sizerville Road (PA 155) > Cowley Hill Road 3.8 mi > Ridge Road 7.0 mi. On that route 3DEP gives 7.4% over the steepest 1.2 km and one run of 8.5% for 850 m (steepest 200 m 10.3%) on Cowley Hill Road; Ridge Road itself peaks at 4.6% over 1.2 km. Under the Spade Road yardstick; dry-weather caveat in the note. The Crooked Run Road climb itself was NOT profiled (not routable).
Waterfront: stays not waterfront; NHD shows no water within 200 m (ridge top).
